This is a remote position.

Red Ember Recruitment is currently recruiting for a Regional Sales Manager specializing in Tyre Distribution and Retail for their client (This is a regional role, and we are looking for suitable candidates all over South Africa).

The Regional Sales Manager operates as a high‑impact territory sales specialist, responsible for expanding the retail and wholesale footprint across the tyre and fitment industry. This role focuses on personally developing new business, strengthening key customer relationships, and driving regional growth in an industry experiencing strong upward momentum.

This position is ideal for an individual with tyre retail and wholesale experience who excels in relationship‑driven selling and is passionate about regional market development.

​

Requirements

Key Responsibilities
Grow the regional sales footprint by identifying, pursuing, and closing new retail and wholesale opportunities.
Build strong, long-term relationships with tyre fitment centres, fleet operators, independent retailers, wholesalers, and commercial customers.
Drive sales execution aligned with evolving market trends, including digital fitment solutions, rising mobility demand, and growth in the logistics and mining sectors.
Promote value-added fitment centre offerings and support the expansion of regional service capabilities.
Analyse competitor activity, pricing trends, and advancements in tyre technology (including EV-ready and smart tyres).
Conduct territory planning, manage a sales pipeline, and provide accurate forecasting and reporting.
Represent the brand professionally at customer visits, industry events, and supplier engagements.
Industry and Market Knowledge
Strong understanding of tyre retail and fitment centre operations.
Insights into market shifts, including sustainability trends, local manufacturing investment, and franchise expansion.
Technical understanding of tyre categories, performance characteristics, and regulatory standards.
Solid commercial sales experience across B2B and B2C channels.
Understanding of pricing, margin dynamics, and territory-based forecasting.
Qualifications and Experience
Matric
BCom Degree or studying toward a relevant Business Degree or Diploma
Minimum 10+ years sales experience, ideally with 5+ years in tyre retail, wholesale, or fitment
Proven track record in territory growth and key account management
Strong understanding of the South African automotive and tyre sector
Skills and Competencies
Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills.
High energy, driven, and resilient – with a strong hunter mentality.
Professional communication skills (verbal and written).
Strong problem-solving and commercial reasoning.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
Bilingual ability is advantageous.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).

Industry: Automotive MNC
Location: Malaysia
Working Hours: Monday - Friday
Good Remuneration Package

﻿Responsibilities:

You will be the main interface between the management office in SG and the local customers, guaranteeing that all transactions and flows follow proper compliances, regulations and legal requirements.

  • Customer, accounts assistance and representation
    • Act as first contact point for direct customers
    • Support on the territory business development plan creation.
    • Inform the Company on a regular basis about any developments with respect to the economic position and liquidity of the Companys clients.
    • Ensure a constant and smooth flow of orders.
    • Supervise payments and collections.
    • Represent the company whenever necessary and formally requested.
  • Market landscape:
    • Assist on building data intelligence related to the registered vehicles and imported vehicles statistics in the territory.
    • Registered vehicles by category presently circulating, on each market.
    • Tyre brands and their approximate share of the market statistics.
    • Name of local importers and distributors.
  • Tyre market structure development:
    • Distribution system and Go-To-Market Strategy.
    • Price and discount levels.
    • Product performance and demand trends.
  • Support on local regulations
    • Import and customs tariffs for all categories of tyres, on each market.
    • Technical regulations and product certifications.

Requirements:

  • Degree with 5 - 10 years of experience in sales management.
  • Experience working with Tier-1 Tyre manufacturers is a major advantage.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel & Outlook.
  • Be a great communicator and display sales vocation in order to listen well, convince and engage.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to effectively interact with all teams, regional markets and top management.
  • Outgoing and expansive profile, as developing rapport and having skills to manage the relationship with our customers is extremely important.
  • Confident, positive, resilient and target driven.
  • Fully remote role (no office in Malaysia).
  • Must be available for regional & occasional overseas travel as per business needs.

What company offer:

Competitive salary + performance bonus (up to 200% of base salary).
Yearly loyalty bonus based on contract completion.
Aggressive growth opportunities in the region.
Flexible working hours, self-managed schedule.
Business expenses fully covered (per company policy).

Yearly renewable long-term contract.

All Successful candidates can expect a very competitive remuneration package and a comprehensive range of benefits.

We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
